assign.request: I want to stress the need for presentational layouts (think slide deck designs), that utilize the space better. try slicing the 3440 in various ratios, and trying to figure out what kind of content (content as navigation) works in each region. for navigation, we want to explore persistent navigation (the navigation stays, a different region switches) vs switching/swapping: when you click, the whole area swaps.
assign.now: scoping - reading the screens lab this stands on
steps: read prior art (screens, shells, findings, columns)
build the slice set (ratios + content kinds)
build persistent vs swap head to head

assign.now: verified headless - 72 loads at 400/1920/3440, zero errors; writing docs

log.msg: MEASURED: a grow weight is NOT a share. flex: 61.8 1 0 gave 1159/759 (1.527) at 1920 because a zero basis is a zero BORDER box and a padded region floors at its own padding. A percentage basis gives 1185/733 = 1.618 exactly, at 1920 and 3440 alike.

CONTENT-KIND MAP: statement/stage scale with a region, wall adds columns, notes cap at their measure and centre, list DOES NOT SCALE. Four of five kinds take a share and get better; a nav list takes a share and gets a chevron chasm.

CUT: quarters (25x4). At 1920 each column is 479px and the display title lands at 48px, where the 2x2 gets 71px from the same four cells - the cut destroys the kind it was built for. Shots kept at shots/cut-quarters-1920.png vs kept-four-1920.png.
PERSISTENT NAV needs no mechanism: the rail is the PARENT column and the slides are its children, so the row already replaces one child at a time. Two token overrides in a stylesheet, no JS.

MEASURED and REJECTED: a 22% rail. At 3440 that is 757px holding a 416px list with 170px of nothing each side - this labs own finding says a list wants a FIXED track. 16em now: the stage keeps 3152 of 3440 instead of 2683.

VERIFIED: 24 urls x 400/1920/3440 = 72 loads, zero console errors, zero icon misses. Only two screens scroll and both are 400 three-region cuts, by design. persist + swap navigated 3 hops each, pitch walked end to end with click + arrows + Back, cold load on slide five lands on slide five.

assign.outcome:
**Nine slide-grade cuts at [/imagine/decks/](/imagine/decks/)** - six ratios, a persistent-vs-swap head to head on identical content, and a real 6-slide deck about the framework. 75 loads at 400/1920/3440, zero console errors.

![the 20/60/20 poster at 3440](/framework/ai/2026-08-30/decks-lab/shots/slice-poster-3440.png)

**The slices that earned keeping** - [50/50](/imagine/decks/half/) (peers only) - [61.8/38.2](/imagine/decks/golden/) (the workhorse) - [70/30](/imagine/decks/aside/) (the 30 must hold prose) - [25/50/25](/imagine/decks/triptych/) (the presenter's shape) - [20/60/20](/imagine/decks/poster/) (**best for a 3440**: 687/2062/687, a 142px word) - [2x2](/imagine/decks/four/) (one cell takes the accent).

**The content-kind map** ([doc/regions.md](/imagine/decks/doc/regions.md)) - one property separates the five kinds: how each answers a wider region. `statement` and `stage` scale, `wall` adds columns, `notes` caps at its measure, `list` **does not scale at all**. Four of five take a share and get better; a nav list takes a share and gets a chevron chasm. That single rule decides every cut.

**Persistent vs swap** ([persist](/imagine/decks/persist/) - [swap](/imagine/decks/swap/), same four slides): the kinds that CAP want the rail - six wall columns either way, the rail comes out of the gutter. The kinds that SCALE want the swap - a 16em rail took the statement from 132px to 113px at 1920. Third answer, and what the real deck ships: a strip redrawn per slide reads as persistent for a 2.5em band instead of a 16em column.

**The real deck** - [/imagine/decks/pitch/](/imagine/decks/pitch/), six honest slides (no build, pages are navigation, the column row, the generator, every slide is a url, what it costs). Click, arrows and Back all move it; cold-load on slide five lands on slide five.

**Cut: quarters (25x4).** At 1920 each column is 479px and the display title lands at 48px, where the 2x2 gets 67px from the same four cells - the cut destroys the kind it was built for. [Evidence](/framework/ai/2026-08-30/decks-lab/shots/cut-quarters-1920.png) kept.

**The measured correction worth stealing:** `flex: 61.8 1 0` is NOT 61.8%. A zero basis is a zero BORDER box, so a padded region floors at its own padding - 1159/759 = 1.527 where the page claimed 1.618. A percentage basis gives 1.618 exactly at both widths.
